name: M3 socket-head cap screw (DIN 912 envelope)
summary: Thread-free M3 socket-head cap screw envelope: 5.5 mm head dia x 3 mm high, 3 mm shank, 2.5 mm hex socket. Origin on the head bearing face, shank along -Z.
preview: M3 SHCS envelope, head 5.5x3 mm, shank 3 mm, length 6-30 mm (default 12)

length.doc: shank length below the head, mm

component.frame: head bearing face; head spans 0..+k in Z, shank runs -Z
simplifications: no under-head fillet or washer face
hex socket is a straight prism, not a broached form
